summary.root_cause_text: v1.6 deploy (payments client HTTP library upgrade) broke payment calls: Decimal amounts not JSON serializable, so orders were processed without payment.
recommended: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client and add a test before redeploying
Add an alert on payment provider call failures, which were logged only at DEBUG
